title: Data Engineer
description:
What is Teachable?

Teachable is a no-code platform for creators who want to build a more impactful business through courses, coaching, downloadable content, and community. With Teachable, creators can engage their online audiences and get paid—on their own terms. Today, tens of thousands of creators use Teachable to share their knowledge and, to date, have reached more than 46 million students around the world.

Are you ready to join a dynamic, cross-cultural team at an exciting turning point in our company’s journey? Now part of the global Hotmart Company portfolio, Teachable continues to take the creator economy by storm as a true industry leader. Together, Teachable and Hotmart are delivering market-leading products that prioritize creator control and flexibility, alongside meaningful partnership and support from our team. If you have big ideas, relish the chance to challenge convention, and deeply believe in the power of creators to shape the future, we want you on our team!



About your Team

At Teachable, our Data Team is all about getting things done with minimal overhead. We work closely together, sharing ideas, designing efficient systems, and building a robust data platform that supports the entire organization. Reporting to the Data Engineering Manager, you’ll take the lead on key initiatives, from optimizing our data platform to shaping the future of our events pipeline and ETL processes.

Our data infrastructure is primarily hosted on AWS. We leverage managed Airflow for orchestration, managed Kafka for event collection, Redshift for analytics, and S3 for data lake storage. Working as a Mid-level Analyst, you will partner with Finance to build metrics and data models that facilitate data exploration and business logic integration, supporting the continuous improvement of the data platform.


The Impact You'll Make

In this role, you'll be at the heart of our data strategy, taking ownership of mission-critical infrastructure that supports teams across the company. You’ll also have the opportunity to make strategic recommendations on how we can evolve our data platform to stay ahead of the curve.


What You’ll Do

  • Partner with Engineering and Product teams on high-impact initiatives.
  • Design and implement robust data pipelines using AWS services.
  • Enhance event collection, queueing, and processing mechanisms.
  • Build and refine meaningful alerts with automated corrective actions.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues, ensuring system reliability and stability.
  • Architect scalable data products with long-term vision and efficiency in mind.
  • Identify and resolve complex technical challenges involving system integration, infrastructure, and software bugs.


About You

  • 2-3+ years of experience in Data Engineering
  • Fluency in English is required
  • Strong knowledge of modern data engineering practices and software engineering principles
  • Solid experience with cloud infrastructure, especially AWS data services
  • Advanced understanding of relational data modeling
  • Strong SQL skills and Python for data wrangling
  • Hands-on experience with data lake technologies (Delta Lake, Hudi, or Iceberg)
  • Experience working with large-scale data warehouses (e.g., Redshift)
  • Experience integrating with RESTful APIs and webhooks
  • Familiarity with DevOps practices, Git version control, and clean coding standards
  • Exposure to monitoring and incident management tools (e.g., CloudWatch, New Relic, PagerDuty)
  • Collaborative team player who values diversity and cross-functional collaboration


  • Nice to have:
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform )
  • Experience building and orchestrating data pipelines using Airflow and Spark


This is a CLT contract with full benefits, paid in $BRL.


This position will be located remotely in Brazil working with Teachable’s data team based in the United States and Hotmart’s data team in Brazil.

Lead Awareness & Performance Tracking

title: Senior Recruiter/Headhunter
description:
The role

Adsora is a performance marketing company focused on affiliate offers. We are hiring a senior recruiter who can run end-to-end hiring for high-impact roles, starting with a senior Meta media buyer who has recently scaled affiliate offers from $5k to $100k per day on Meta (proof required). Experience across YouTube, TikTok, and native is a plus.


This is not a “post a job and wait” role. You will hunt, qualify, and close talent. You will also own a set of VA-style support tasks that keep the hiring machine and daily ops moving.

We currently manage about $500k per month in Meta spend and we want to scale faster with A-level operators.


Mission

Build and run a predictable hiring pipeline that consistently lands operators who can scale paid social profitably, starting with a senior Meta affiliate media buyer.


What success looks like First 30 days
  • Fill the senior Meta buyer role (or have multiple final-stage candidates ready).
  • Build a clear scorecard and interview plan for the senior Meta buyer role (and next roles in the queue).
  • Launch outbound sourcing across multiple channels (LinkedIn, communities, referrals, databases, etc.).
  • Deliver a steady flow of qualified candidates each week (not just resumes).
  • Run structured screens that filter for real affiliate scaling experience, proof, and owner mindset.
  • Set up a clean tracking system for the pipeline (stages, notes, next steps, rejection reasons).

    • By 90 days
    • Fill 2-8 roles.


    By 12 months
    • Own recruiting as a system: documented sourcing playbooks, question banks, scorecards, and evaluation rubrics.
    • Consistently fill priority roles fast with high retention and high output hires.
    • Be the internal “talent operator” who can scale the team as spend scales.


    Responsibilities Recruiting and interviewing
    • Own the full recruiting cycle: sourcing, outreach, screening, interview coordination, follow-ups, references, offers.
    • Write and post job listings, then actively recruit instead of waiting for applicants.
    • Run structured screens focused on proof, recent performance, decision quality, and ownership.
    • Coordinate skills tests and case studies (and keep candidates moving quickly).
    • Build candidate packets for the hiring manager: summary, proof, strengths/risks, compensation expectations, notes.
    • Keep the process tight: fast response times, clean communication, no dropped balls.
    “Proof-first” candidate validation
    • Validate recent spend, results, and context (offer type, tracking, payout structure, constraints).
    • Spot inflated claims and surface the real story behind performance screenshots.
    • Ask the questions that reveal if someone can truly scale, not just maintain.
    VA and ops support (light but important)
    • Calendar management for interviews and internal meetings.
    • Inbox support for hiring related messages and candidate follow-ups.
    • Basic research tasks (talent lists, role benchmarks, competitor hiring patterns, community sourcing).
    • Keep docs organized (scorecards, interview notes, pipelines, templates, candidate folders).


    Who you are
    • You have recruited for performance marketing roles before (media buyers, affiliate marketers, creative, editors, tracking/ops).
    • You understand the language of direct response: CPA, CPL, EPC, payouts, margins, tracking, attribution, postbacks.
    • You can confidently screen a “senior Meta buyer” and know what real proof looks like.
    • You are persistent and comfortable sending lots of outbound messages without getting precious about rejection.
    • You write clearly and follow up like a professional. Candidates do not slip through the cracks.
    • You move fast, keep things organized, and you do not need hand-holding.


    Core values fit
    • Resourcefulness: You figure it out and bring options, not problems.
    • Good and fast beats perfect: You ship the first version, then improve.
    • Constructive disagreement: You call out weak logic and hype, respectfully.
    • Kind, not nice: You give honest feedback and protect the company from bad hires.
    • Growth mindset: You learn quickly and tighten the process every week.
    • Full ownership: You treat hiring like a revenue lever, not an admin task.


    Offer and compensation
    • Base pay (based on location and experience).
    • Performance bonuses tied to outcomes like roles filled and sustained for 3, and 12 months.
    • Long-term upside if you become our core talent operator as the team scales.


    How to apply

    Email with:

    • A short note on your recruiting background (what roles you have filled, and for what kinds of companies)
    • Your sourcing channels and process (what actually works for you)
    • 1–2 examples of candidates you successfully placed (role, why they were strong, how you found them)
    • Your availability and desired compensation (base + per-hire bonus expectations)

Na PayConductor, estamos construindo a infraestrutura de dados que vai alimentar a próxima geração de inteligência em pagamentos. Não estamos falando de dashboardzinhos bonitos, estamos falando de pipelines robustos que ingerem dados de adquirentes, bandeiras, Banco Central, e transformam tudo isso em combustível para IAs que tomam decisões em milissegundos.

Se você acha que um pipeline bem arquitetado é uma obra de arte, que data quality é questão de honra, e que \"funciona na minha máquina\" não é resposta aceitável, vem com a gente.


Responsabilidades

  • Projetar e implementar pipelines de dados escaláveis para ingestão de múltiplas fontes (APIs de adquirentes, arquivos de bandeiras, dados regulatórios).
  • Garantir qualidade, consistência e governança dos dados que alimentam os agentes de IA.
  • Construir data lakes e data warehouses que façam sentido (não aquele cemitério de tabelas que ninguém entende).
  • Implementar processos de ETL/ELT eficientes e monitoráveis.
  • Colaborar com o time de ML para garantir que os dados estejam no formato certo, na hora certa, no lugar certo.
  • Documentar schemas, linhagem de dados e processos como se o próximo engenheiro fosse um serial killer que sabe seu endereço.


Qualificações

  • Experiência sólida com Python e SQL (SQL de verdade, não só SELECT *).
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de orquestração (Airflow, Dagster, Prefect).
  • Experiência com cloud (AWS, GCP ou Azure) e seus serviços de dados.
  • Familiaridade com bancos relacionais e não-relacionais.
  • Entendimento de princípios de data quality e data governance.
  • Capacidade de debugar um pipeline às 23h sem chorar (muito).
  • Diferenciais: experiência com dados financeiros/transacionais, conhecimento de streaming de dados (Kafka, Kinesis), familiaridade com o ecossistema de pagamentos mundial.

Entendemos que fluxo de navegação e design visual são diferenciais competitivos estratégicos, por isso precisamos de um profissional altamente qualificado para criar telas que combinem minimalismo e elegância, alinhadas à nossa solução.

Somos especializados na coleta, análise e distribuição de dados jurídicos, conectando profissionais e empresas às informações essenciais para decisões mais assertivas. Nosso objetivo é atuar como um hub de soluções jurídicas, oferecendo inteligência de dados para otimizar estratégias e aprimorar processos. Buscamos impactar positivamente nossos parceiros com ferramentas práticas e transformadoras.

As atividades incluem desenvolver protótipos de alta fidelidade no Figma, aplicar conceitos de design thinking e design visual, além de otimizar continuamente as interações dos usuários. Este é um cargo de meio período (4 horas/dia) com atuação 100% remota.


Qualificações Essenciais


  • Design e usabilidade: Domínio avançado de design thinking, prototipagem no Figma e práticas de design visual que equilibrem funcionalidade e estética;
  • Experiência do usuário: Experiência sólida em UX Design (User Experience Design);
  • Colaboração: Habilidade para trabalhar de forma colaborativa com desenvolvedores, analistas de dados e equipes multidisciplinares;

title: Accounting Manager
description:
Accounting Manager (Remote) – USA Clients

Location: Remote – LatAm

Salary: USD 2,500/month

Schedule: Based around US Timezones


About Us

We are a dynamic and growing U.S.-based accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for an Accounting Manager to join our remote team.

The Accounting Manager (AM) is an expert responsible for overseeing financial accounting and transaction processing. They serve as ambassadors of TGG Way™ and US GAAP accounting standards . Accounting Managers provide 100% accurate and complete financial statements to Controllers. They play a key role in training and mentoring staff (both internal and external) on internal controls, systems, and processes following the TGG Way™ .

Additionally, Accounting Managers act as a bridge between TGG and the client , ensuring continuous communication, implementing processes, addressing client needs, and relaying key information to other team members.


Responsibilities

Financial Close & Month-End Management

  • Lead the month-end close process, ensuring adherence to the timeline and checklist.
  • Review final profit & loss (P&L) scrub and approve journal entries prepared by staff.
  • Ensure the accuracy of the balance sheet workbook, including spot-checking source document filing.
  • Review and update financial notes, charts, graphs, and footnotes to ensure alignment with KPIs and executive summaries.

Financial Reporting & Analysis

  • Oversee the preparation of financial statements, including income statements, balance sheets, and cash flow reports.
  • Identify and resolve discrepancies in financial reports through variance analysis.
  • Review staff-prepared financial statements and supporting schedules.
  • Ensure financial accuracy and consistency across all reports and KPIs.

Budgeting, Forecasting & Cash Flow Management

  • Lead budgeting and forecasting efforts for real estate projects, including capital expenditures and operating costs.
  • Provide financial insights and recommendations to support cost-saving initiatives and revenue growth.
  • Update and maintain cash flow forecasts regularly.

Tax Compliance & Regulatory Filings

  • Prepare and submit sales tax returns with controller approval.
  • Coordinate, review, and submit annual 1099s.
  • Support the preparation and submission of personal property tax filings, reviewed by the controller.
  • Calculate monthly sales tax payments and submit them for controller review and remittance.

Accounting Operations & Oversight

  • Manage recurring weekly accounting processes as outlined by the controller.
  • Review customer invoicing, vendor bills, and process payments.
  • Approve and submit payroll.
  • Perform chart of accounts reviews and reclassify contributions/distributions to retained earnings as needed.

Team Leadership & Cross-Department Collaboration

  • Supervise and mentor junior accounting staff, fostering development in real estate accounting practices.
  • Collaborate with departments including property management, acquisitions, and finance to ensure effective financial operations and decision-making.

Process Improvement & Client Advisory

  • Identify opportunities for process efficiencies and provide actionable recommendations to clients.
  • Maintain strong financial integrity, proactively troubleshoot issues, and ensure compliance with accounting standards.

Tools, Communication & Task Management

  • Refine financial models and improve data structure in Excel.
  • Manage tasks using Asana and track time entries in Bizinta with detailed descriptions.
  • Organize and manage the accounting email inbox to ensure timely and accurate handling of financial documents.


Requirements

  • 5+ years of accounting experience, US based experience or familiarity required
  • Fluency in English (written and spoken).
  • Education: Accounting or Finance degree.
  • Technical Knowledge: Proficiency in QuickBooks Online is a plus and Advanced Excel skills is required (complex formulas, data structuring, and basic financial modeling).
  • Strong attention to detail, accuracy, and problem-solving mindset.
  • Ability to prepare financial statements, carry out a month-end process, record and review journal entries in all accounts, and perform account reconciliations
  • Experience with US based clients and exposure to USGAAP.
  • US Working hours 9am to 5pm Eastern Standard Time.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with a remote team.


Perks & Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO Policy , including all Holidays
  • 1 Month of Paid training in advanced accounting, U.S. GAAP, and QuickBooks Online
  • Full access to TGG University and learning materials
  • Career development through mentoring, training, and long-term growth opportunities


Notes:

This position is to join us as Independent Contractor

Payment after 90 days will be based on hours worked

Working Equipment to start is required

PTO before 90 days will be taken as unpaid unless it's a holiday or sick leave



About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.

The People Operations and Support (POPS) Team at TGG handles both the operational and human sides of the business. We’re a tight-knit, cross-functional group that collaborates closely with leaders across the company and with each other. Our work is fast-paced and wide-ranging, and we’re always looking for better ways to support our people and help the business run smoothly.


Our Core Values:

  • Loyalty
  • Integrity
  • Strong Work Ethic
  • Forward Thinking – Growth Mindset
  • Team Player / Caring / Selfless
  • Positive Energy – People who have fun, smile, and laugh
  • Freedom & Accountability

Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills.   • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). title: TikTok & Meta Media Buyer
description:
We're hiring a TikTok & Meta Media Buyer to drive exceptional paid advertising results for a portfolio of enterprise and celebrity brands—plus fuel agency growth. Our client is a Gold Star TikTok Shop Partner led by a former TikTok employee and a seasoned agency owner. You'll manage high-budget campaigns and deliver record-breaking performance for our brand partners while scaling our agency through strategic lead generation campaigns.


What You'll Do:


Client Campaign Management:


  • Manage and optimize TikTok ad campaigns, driving maximum ROAS for D2C brands across feed ads, spark ads, live shopping ads, and product shopping ads.
  • Scale Meta advertising campaigns (Facebook & Instagram) using proven TikTok-to-Meta playbooks, leveraging winning creative and audience strategies across both platforms.
  • Run continuous A/B tests on creative, audiences, placements, and bidding strategies across TikTok and Meta to improve performance and scale profitably.
  • Analyze campaign data daily across both platforms to identify opportunities and optimize key metrics including ROAS, CPA, CTR, and conversion rates.
  • Collaborate with creative teams to develop high-performing ad concepts and provide data-driven feedback on what's working across TikTok and Meta formats.
  • Adjust budgets, bids, and targeting in real-time to maximize performance while minimizing wasted spend on both platforms.


Agency Growth:


  • Design and execute lead generation campaigns across Meta to attract enterprise and celebrity brand partners.
  • Test and optimize agency acquisition funnels, landing pages, and lead magnets to drive qualified inbound opportunities.
  • Track and report on agency marketing ROI, cost per lead, and lead-to-client conversion rates.


Strategic Collaboration:


  • Partner with Account Managers to align paid media with organic and affiliate strategies for cohesive brand growth.
  • Stay ahead of TikTok and Meta platform updates, beta features, and advertising best practices to maintain competitive advantages.


What You Need:


  • 2-4 years in paid social media buying with hands-on TikTok Ads Manager and Meta Ads Manager experience
  • Proven track record managing $100K+ monthly ad budgets for e-commerce brands across TikTok and Meta
  • Experience with B2B lead generation or agency marketing campaigns (preferred but not required)
  • Strong grasp of performance metrics: ROAS, CPA, CAC, LTV, CTR, CPL
  • Proficiency with TikTok Ads Manager, Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics, and reporting tools
  • Excellent communication skills for presenting performance and strategy to clients
  • Creative eye for identifying winning ad concepts and adapting them cross-platform
  • Highly organized with ability to manage multiple high-budget accounts plus internal campaigns
  • Passion for performance marketing, platform trends, and growth marketing


What Success Looks Like:


  • Consistently exceed client ROAS targets while maintaining clients Top 10 partner status.
  • Successfully scale TikTok campaigns to Meta, achieving profitable expansion across both platforms.
  • Generate qualified agency leads at target CPL while optimizing conversion rates through the sales funnel.
  • Develop innovative testing strategies that uncover breakthrough audiences and creative approaches.
  • Proactively identify optimization opportunities and scale campaigns profitably.
  • Build trusted client relationships through transparent reporting and strategic insights.


The Team:


You'll collaborate with Account Managers, Creative teams, Affiliate specialists, and a Shop Operations team under our founding leadership. We're performance-driven and results-focused, maintaining our Top 10 ranking through constant innovation and testing. Everyone contributes ideas and insights to drive record-breaking results.


The Culture:


  • Performance Pioneers – Challenge conventional wisdom, test innovative strategies, and constantly seek improvements that exceed benchmarks.
  • Data-Driven Winners – Make decisions based on metrics and statistical significance, not gut feelings. Track everything and optimize relentlessly.
  • Brand Obsessed – Communicate clearly with clients, exceed their expectations, and build the trusted partnerships that make us the preferred TikTok Shop partner.

title: CRO, UX Product Specialist (Onboarding, Content) | Remote, Part-time 20-30 hrs
description:
To Apply

Please complete this form:


LOCATION

Remote — Western Europe, Latin America (Argentina, Brasil/Brazil, Uruguay, Chile, Colombia)


About FullSession

FullSession is a user behavior analytics platform that helps teams understand how people really use their product or website, remove UX friction, and prove the impact of changes on activation, conversion, and revenue. Our customers span SaaS , Ecommerce/DTC , and Enterprise customer portals (finance, insurance, travel, etc.).

We’re building toward a world where teams go from seeing what happened → knowing what to fix next → validating lift.


The Role

We’re looking for a hybrid Product + CRO/UX Specialist who can wear three hats:

  • Customer onboarding & demo specialist: help prospects/customers get to “first value” fast (this is not a sales role)
  • CRO expert : diagnose funnel friction, propose experiments, and validate impact
  • Content contributor : turn real work into practical writing (CRO/UX playbooks, teardown-style posts, case studies)

This is a hands-on role. You’ll be in the product, in real customer journeys, and in front of customers.


What You’ll Do

CRO / UX & Experimentation:

  • Audit key journeys (signup → activation, onboarding, checkout, forms, critical flows) using session replay, heatmaps, funnels, and feedback.
  • Identify friction, quantify opportunity size, and prioritize a clear backlog of improvements.
  • Propose experiments and UX changes with strong hypotheses, expected impact, and success metrics.
  • Partner with product/engineering to specify changes (flow, copy, layout, instrumentation) and ensure tracking is correct.
  • Help validate lift (conversion, activation, completion, revenue per visitor, drop-off reduction) and document learnings.

Customer Onboarding & Demos (CS, not sales):

  • Run onboarding calls and product walkthroughs; help teams install/implement and reach “first insights” quickly.
  • Translate customer goals into a simple measurement plan (events/funnels) and a short list of “what to fix first.”
  • Collect structured feedback from calls and turn it into actionable product recommendations.

Writing & Thought Leadership (CRO/UX)

  • Co-create short, high-signal content with us: blog posts, case studies, teardown-style insights, and playbooks.
  • Share best practices for CRO, UX, and experimentation across SaaS, Ecommerce, and high-stakes portals.
  • Optionally publish under your name (with transparency/disclosure where relevant).


What Success Looks Like (First 60–90 Days)

  • Customers reach “first value” faster (clearer onboarding, faster first insights, fewer setup blockers).
  • A repeatable onboarding playbook (talk tracks, checklists, templates).
  • A prioritized list of product + UX improvements informed by real data and real calls.


Requirements

  • 3+ years in CRO/UX optimization and/or Product Management for a live website/web app (B2B SaaS and/or Ecommerce).
  • Strong experimentation skills: hypothesis design, metrics, A/B testing fundamentals, interpreting results.
  • Strong analytics + behavior tooling experience (GA4 and a replay/heatmap/funnel tool such as FullSession, Hotjar, etc.).
  • Comfortable moving between quantitative and qualitative signals (funnels/events + replays/feedback).
  • Strong written English: you can explain what you found, what you changed, and why it mattered.
  • High ownership: you work independently, communicate clearly async, and ship work without heavy supervision.


Nice to have

  • Experience with onboarding/implementation for analytics tools (tagging, events, confirmation that data is flowing).
  • Familiarity with privacy considerations (masking, PII, consent, compliance).
  • Experience writing for Product/Growth audiences (LinkedIn, Medium, blog).


What We Offer

  • Flexible, remote-friendly engagement (start part-time 20+ hours; option to expand).
  • Fair compensation at $23/hr -- FT equivalent (173.3 hrs) = $3,986
  • Work on meaningful CRO/UX problems with modern behavior analytics tooling.
  • Direct exposure to product strategy and real customer journeys.
  • Opportunities to build your public portfolio via co-authored content.


To Apply

description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. title: Operations Manager
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide.

Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards.

Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team.

Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

Operational Leadership

  • Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics.
  • Training and Development: Conduct initial and ongoing training for QC Coordinators (QCCs), maintaining minimal errors and supporting development. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators.
  • IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become "super-users" of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business.
  • Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives.
  • Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager.
  • Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards.
  • Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum's capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum's strengths in client meetings to support business development.
  • Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed.
  • CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager.
  • Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required.

Team Development

  • Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start.
  • Performance and Probation Management: Lead 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews for new hires, ensuring development aligns with company standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations and address skill gaps through targeted training.

Compliance & QHSE

  • Process Optimisation: Act as a "process expert" within Fulkrum, supporting the Integrated Management System (IMS) and continuous process improvements. Collaborate on IRIS developments and provide training for each improvement.
  • Focal Point: for QHSE and Compliance during internal/external audits, draft and implement CARs as necessary, support all IMS initiatives for process improvements.

Commercial

  • Proposal and Contract Support: Support bid preparation, draft project-specific execution plans and procedures, create/approve rate sheets, perform contract renewals, and support all other commercial requirements as needed.
  • Insurance and Compliance: Coordinate insurance documents, bank letters, and tax documentation, ensuring sufficient coverage for client projects.

Team Culture and Engagement

  • Team Building: Foster a positive and inclusive office culture, organising team events and maintaining a supportive environment. Promote retention through effective leadership and engagement initiatives.
  • Engagement: Drive any engagement survey initiatives and follow up on global, regional and local actions to ensure continuous engagement of the team.

Client Account Management

  • Client Service Reviews: Schedule meetings with key clients to evaluate service quality and implement corrective actions as necessary.
  • Business Development Support: Assist the Regional Manager and Key Account Managers in bidding, negotiating contracts, presenting to prospective clients, and identifying new business opportunities.
  • Growth and Forecasting: Monitor project forecasts, ensure proper onboarding of new clients, and communicate budget impacts to the Regional Manager and Finance Department.

Coordination Responsibilities

  • Client Support: Manage client requests for QA/QC, Engineering, and Project Support, ensuring prompt and accurate fulfilment.
  • Candidate Management: Source candidates, prepare them for interviews, and coordinate their placement, handling contractual and performance-related concerns throughout their assignments.
  • Service Level Agreements: Ensure adherence to all client SLAs and Fulkrum KPIs, negotiating inspector rates to support office margins.

Qualifications and Skills

  • Minimum 10 years of industry experience, with 5 years in a leadership role.
  • Extensive knowledge of oil and gas projects, both onshore and offshore.
  • Proficient in MS Office; CRM experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated client relationship management skills, with the ability to thrive in fast-paced environments.

Personal Attributes

  • Highly organised, process-oriented, and capable of multitasking.
  • Strong leadership skills with a proven ability to motivate and guide teams.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Willingness to support personnel and clients outside of standard hours as necessary.

Additional Information:

This is a pivotal role within the organisation, requiring exceptional interpersonal skills, keen attention to detail, and a comprehensive understanding of the oil and gas industry. The ideal candidate will be a strong team leader who consistently delivers the highest standards of service to clients. Candidates with a background in the coordination or management of large projects, a thorough knowledge of Fulkrum's coordination and accounts processes, and a proven ability to build and nurture client relationships will excel in this position. This individual will inspire their team to meet and exceed company goals, driving both performance and growth.

Travel

Travel will frequently be required throughout the Region.

HSE Awareness:

All personnel are informed of Fulkrum's Health and Safety policy and procedures during the onboarding process. Any HSE incidents must be reported and logged with the QHSE Manager, who will oversee and support any subsequent investigations.

Why Join Us?

This is an exciting opportunity for a driven Operations Manager to showcase their expertise in a supportive and collaborative environment. At Fulkrum, you'll make a tangible impact while advancing your career in the thriving global business sector.

We offer a fantastic working environment with a highly engaged team and consistently high eNPS scores. Fulkrum's success in attracting new clients and expanding our global footprint is a testament to our excellence and dedication. We have regular reward and recognition initiatives, a social budget, and a refer-a-friend scheme to ensure our team feels valued and motivated.

Join us to be part of a high-performing team with ample opportunities for skill enhancement and development. Be a part of our success story and contribute to our continued growth and innovation.

Apply now and become a valued part of our growing team!

Fulkrum

title: Lower School Makerspace Teacher

title: Computational Scientist
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world's largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties

We seek a talented Computational Scientist with an M.Sc. in Computational Science or Engineering and academic and/or professional experience. A Ph.D. degree with a strong background in Computational Science is a plus. The ideal candidate for this position is an expert in porting complex scientific programming codes to parallel hybrid (CPU+GPU) clusters. You must have a passion for optimizing and improving code speed-up. Excellent problem-solving ability and good oral and written communication skills in both English and Portuguese are required.

You will join a multidisciplinary and diverse team of scientists and engineers committed to delivering high-end computational technologies and tools for the O&G and broader Energy industry.

Qualifications

  • Expert knowledge of modern C++ (e.g., C++11, C++14, C++17).
  • Expert knowledge of GPGPU frameworks/software layers such as CUDA and OpenCL.
  • Expert knowledge of distributed and parallel computing in hybrid (CPU and GPU) clusters.
  • Good knowledge of device-level optimization and GPU architecture.
  • Good knowledge of modern C++ design patterns and software engineering concepts (e.g., template metaprogramming, generic programming, etc.).
  • Ability to work in both Windows and Linux environments.
  • Some experience with programming/scripting languages such as Python and Matlab.
  • Some experience with MPI programming.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Proven experience porting legacy serial or MPI/OpenMP code to GPUs.
  • Knowledge of scientific computing (e.g., linear and nonlinear solvers, numerical methods, etc.).
  • Familiarity with computational mathematics (e.g., linear algebra, calculus, matrix decompositions, etc.).
  • Knowledge of PDE discretization methods, such as Finite Element, Finite Volume, or Lattice Boltzmann.
  • Familiarity with open-source scientific computing libraries (e.g., HYPRE, BOOST++, PETSC, DUNE, LAPACK, etc.).
  • Familiarity with CMake, Makefiles, and other tools for multi-platform code compilation.
  • Knowledge of fluid flow physics.

Resumo da Função: Excelência em Recrutamento de Nível Concierge

Estamos buscando um Analista de Recrutamento Júnior para oferecer um serviço de recrutamento "white glove" e de nível concierge para nosso estimado cliente farmacêutico, com foco no mercado brasileiro. Esta função exige um indivíduo de natureza polida, orientado a processos e que possua uma forte mentalidade de serviço com habilidades de comunicação superiores e uma atenção aguçada aos detalhes.

O Que Você Fará

A função principal desta posição é gerenciar o recrutamento de ciclo completo com a disciplina meticulosa exigida para perfis de indústria complexos (por exemplo, Produtos Farmacêuticos, Dispositivos Médicos, Aviação).

  • Engajamento de Candidatos e Gerentes de Contratação: Cultivar relacionamentos fortes, atuando como um concierge profissional para garantir uma experiência elevada durante todo o processo.
  • Revisão e Apresentação de Candidatos: Revisar, triar, pré-qualificar e apresentar talentos proativamente, incluindo a capacidade de desmembrar perfis complexos para uma busca eficaz e uma comunicação clara com as partes interessadas.
  • Liderança no Processo de Candidatura: Conduzir os candidatos pelas etapas iniciais do processo de candidatura com foco em velocidade, discrição e qualidade.
  • Conformidade de Processos e Administração de Sistemas: Garantir estabilidade em funções anteriores e gerenciar processos complexos com estrita aderência à conformidade do processo de recrutamento e à administração do Sistema de Rastreamento de Candidatos (ATS).
  • Colaborar em projetos especiais para aprimorar a estratégia e as operações de recrutamento.

O Que Você Precisa Trazer

Candidatos bem-sucedidos são definidos por sua estabilidade, comunicação e abordagem orientada a processos.

  • Experiência: Um mínimo de 1+ ano em uma função de suporte direto a funções de recrutamento e experiência comprovada em recrutamento de ciclo completo por pelo menos um ano.
  • Educação: Bacharelado ou atualmente matriculado para obter um.
  • Comunicação: Excelentes habilidades de comunicação escrita e oral que refletem um profissionalismo de natureza polida.
  • Idiomas: Fluência em Português e Inglês é obrigatória para prospecção no Brasil e colaboração com partes interessadas internacionais. Espanhol é um diferencial.
  • Sistemas: Experiência comprovada com Sistema de Rastreamento de Candidatos (ATS) e um sólido entendimento de produtos MS Office/Google.
  • Mentalidade: Capacidade comprovada de trabalhar em um ambiente de equipe, aceitar direção e executar um plano, e possuir uma forte orientação para detalhes com acompanhamento demonstrada em empregos anteriores.

O Que Você Ganha

  • Junte-se a um líder de mercado global em serviços de RH com reconhecimento da indústria.
  • Junte-se a um local de trabalho diverso e inclusivo.
  • Acesse uma ampla gama de oportunidades de aprendizado e desenvolvimento.
  • Junte-se a uma empresa que oferece um ótimo equilíbrio entre vida profissional e pessoal.
  • Junte-se a uma empresa com processos comprovados e tecnologia de alta produção para criar eficiência.

As candidaturas serão aceitas continuamente até que a vaga seja preenchida.

Junior Recruitment Analyst - Hybrid (Rio de Janeiro, Brazil)

This role requires a minimum of three days per week on-site in our Rio de Janeiro office.

Role Summary: Concierge-Level Recruitment Excellence

We are seeking a Junior Recruitment Analyst to deliver "white glove," concierge-level recruitment service for our esteemed pharmaceutical client, focusing on the Brazilian market. This role demands an individual who is polished in nature, process-driven, and possesses a strong service mindset with superior communication skills and a keen attention to detail.

You are responsible for proactively reviewing candidates to determine if they meet the rigorous requirements and job experience for complex pharmaceutical profiles, ensuring a premium, seamless, and elevated experience for all candidates and stakeholders.

What You Get To Do

The core function of this role is to manage full-cycle recruitment with the meticulous discipline required for complex industry profiles (e.g., Pharmaceuticals, Medical Devices, Aviation).

  • Candidate and Hiring Manager Engagement: Cultivate strong relationships, acting as a professional concierge to ensure an elevated experience throughout the process.
  • Candidate Review & Presentation: Proactively review, screen, pre-qualify, and present talent, including the ability to break down complex profiles for effective searching and clear stakeholder communication.
  • Application Process Leadership: Lead candidates through the initial stages of the application process with a focus on speed, discretion, and quality.
  • Process Compliance & System Administration: Ensure stability in previous roles and manage complex processes with strict adherence to recruitment process compliance and Applicant Tracking System (ATS) administration.
  • Collaborate on special projects to enhance recruitment strategy and operations.

What You Need To Bring

Successful candidates are defined by their stability, communication, and process-driven approach.

  • Experience: A minimum of 1+ year in a role directly supporting recruiting functions and demonstrated full-cycle recruiting experience for at least one year.
  • Education: Bachelor's degree or currently enrolled to obtain one.
  • Communication: Excellent written and oral communication skills that reflect a polished in nature professionalism.
  • Languages: Fluency in both Portuguese and English is required for sourcing within Brazil and collaborating with international stakeholders. Spanish is a plus.
  • Systems: Demonstrated Applicant Tracking System (ATS) experience and a solid understanding of MS Office/Google products.
  • Mindset: Proven ability to work within a team environment, take direction and execute a plan, and possess a strong detail orientation with follow-through shown in previous jobs.

What's In It For You

  • Join a global market leader in HR services with industry recognition.
  • Join a diverse and inclusive workplace.
  • Access a wide range of learning and development opportunities.
  • Join a company that offers a great work/life balance.
  • Join a company with proven processes and high-output technology to create efficiency.

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until filled.

title: Computational Scientist
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world's largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.
Job Duties
We seek a talented Computational Scientist with an M.Sc. in Computational Science or Engineering and academic and/or professional experience. A Ph.D. degree with a strong background in Computational Science is a plus. The ideal candidate for this position is an expert in porting complex scientific programming codes to parallel hybrid (CPU+GPU) clusters. You must have a passion for optimizing and improving code speed-up. Excellent problem-solving ability and good oral and written communication skills in both English and Portuguese are required.
You will join a multidisciplinary and diverse team of scientists and engineers committed to delivering high-end computational technologies and tools for the O&G and broader Energy industry.
Qualifications
Expert knowledge of modern C++ (e.g., C++11, C++14, C++17).
Expert knowledge of GPGPU frameworks/software layers such as CUDA and OpenCL.
Expert knowledge of distributed and parallel computing in hybrid (CPU and GPU) clusters.
Good knowledge of device-level optimization and GPU architecture.
Good knowledge of modern C++ design patterns and software engineering concepts (e.g., template metaprogramming, generic programming, etc.).
Ability to work in both Windows and Linux environments.
Some experience with programming/scripting languages such as Python and Matlab.
Some experience with MPI programming.
Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities
Proven experience porting legacy serial or MPI/OpenMP code to GPUs.
Knowledge of scientific computing (e.g., linear and nonlinear solvers, numerical methods, etc.).

description:
Resumo da função:
Responsável por realizar operações de perfuração e/ou intervenções de poços (workover) operando sondas, sejam elas hidráulicas ou convencionais; liderar as equipes em diversas atividades, com ou sem sonda, tais como: atividades Rig up/Rig & down (montagem e desmontagem), despressurização de poços, slick line, pescaria, wireline, dentre outras, visando pela segurança operacional, ambiental e da equipe.
Responsabilidades:
Conhecer e interpretar os principais dados específicos do poço (profundidade, pressão da formação, densidade do fluido de amortecimento, MAASP, etc), diagrama proposto de equipagem e o diagrama anterior para iniciar/dar continuidade as intervenções do tipo workover
Executar as atividades de assentamento de packer: mecânico e hidráulico, corte de cimento e tampões mecânicos (BPP e BPR) obedecendo e tendo conhecimento dos parâmetros necessários como peso sobre broca e circulação
Garantir a correta execução de atividades de equipagem com conjunto BCS obedecendo os cuidados necessários com a elevação das cargas para não ocorrer a flambagem, obedecendo os cuidados necessários com o manuseio e operação do cabo BCS, spooler, conectores elétricos (pig tail), instalação de clamps e alinhamento do orifício do PTS do suspensor com o adaptador A3EC
Executar inspeções nos equipamentos de manobra (colar de segurança, cunhas manuais e hidráulicas, elevadores de tubo, chave hidráulica) e de elevação (eslingas e cabos) bem como garantir sua integridade antes do início das operações
Realizar o check list diário de inspeção do sondador e garantir o correto preenchimento/inspeção dos demais check lists (torrista e plataformista) pela sua equipe orientando os demais sempre que necessário
Operar a sonda conhecendo os principais riscos inerentes ao tipo e a capacidade da sonda – em sonda convencional deve garantir a correta execução da tonelada milha
Executar e garantir a execução de todos os aspectos de segurança exigidos em atividades em área classificada, trabalho em altura, movimentação de cargas, testes hidrostáticos, H2S, equipamentos rotativos e segurança de poço
Planejar de forma antecipada todos os materiais e ferramentas necessários para a intervenção, bem como garantir a integridade dos equipamentos e ferramentas a bordo comunicando ao supervisor qualquer dano ocorrido
Garantir que a equipe siga rigorosamente o programa do poço atendendo todos os parâmetros exigidos bem como as normas vigentes de segurança operacional e de equipamentos de ESCP
Saber pesquisar e ter em mãos tabelas de cimentação, tabelas hidráulicas, manuais de perfurações, tabelas de tubos e revestimentos, etc.
Controlar todos os parâmetros operacionais do workover: peso sobre broca, densidade e viscosidade do fluido, vazão e pressão de bombeio

Disponibilidade - Amplitude de horário – Plantão noturno - Trabalho Offshore 14x14
Experiência como Sondador de sondas tipo HH Drillmec e ou convencional à cabo 250.000lbs(tipo double joint/mesa rotativa) comprovados em carteira de trabalho;
Experiência comprovada em assentamento de tampões mecânicos e hidráulicos e obturadores (packers);
Experiência em equipagem de poço com coluna BCS;
Conhecimento teórico e prático na atividade de perfuração e/ou completação;

Ensino médio técnico completo

Knowledge of OSS and network management tools.
Strong understanding of commissioning, integration, and troubleshooting processes for 2G/3G/4G/5G networks.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Serviços
description:

O Engenheiro de Serviços proporciona suporte técnico qualificado à base instalada do cliente, conseguindo a satisfação do cliente através da execução dos serviços e contratos de acordo com o escopo e orçamento definido.
Nesse cargo, suas responsabilidades serão:
Assessoramento na elaboração e no cumprimento de programas de manutenção corretiva, preventiva e preditiva, além de assessoria técnica nas intervenções nos sitemas Emerson Machine Automation Solutions (antiga GE Automation & Controls);
Levantamento de dados, elaboração de fluxogramas , diagramas, memórias de cálculo e de estudos, visando a seleção do equipamento, material, execução de um projeto ou a adoção da solução mais econômica para resolução de problemas em instalações industriais de automação, existentes;
Elaboração de projetos básicos contendo Procedimentos Técnicos, Memoriais Descritivos de Construção e Montagem e de Memoriais Descritivos para Contratação de Projetos Executivos, obedecendo aos padrões da PETROBRAS;
Análise de projetos e estudos técnicos de outras empresas, bem como a emissão de Pareceres Técnicos (PATEC) de equipamentos e serviços que envolvam equipamento Emerson;
Serviços para configuração, programação e atualização (i.e. softwares, ladder, hardware, firmware, etc) dos Sistemas de Automação Emerson das Instalações de Produção da PETROBRAS, englobando computadores, redes de comunicação de dados e equipamentos de controle e intertravamento, tais como controladores lógicos programáveis da Emerson (PACSystems RX3i, Versamax, Series 9030 e 9070);
Gerenciamento, monitoração e suporte para supervisórios da GE Digital (implementados ou não em conjunto com PLC da Emerson);
Elaboração, desenvolvimento e execução de projetos de migração de sistemas com equipamentos Emerson descontinuados (obsoletos);
Realizar auditoria técnica nos equipamentos e aplicativos do fabricante, asim como gerenciamento e planejamento de sobressalentes e estoque de equipamentos dos Sistemas de Automação Industrial Emerson;
Comissionamento de novas tecnologias para os sistemas Emerson de Automação Industrial.
Quem você é:
Você toma ações consistentes para desenvolver novas habilidades. Você antecipa conflitos antes que aconteçam, com base no conhecimento sobre dinâmicas interpessoais e de grupo. Você antecipa as necessidades do cliente e oferece serviços que vão além das expectativas dele. Você fornece informações úteis e no momento certo para pessoas em toda a organização. Você age de forma rápida e decisiva em situações imprevisíveis e que mudam rapidamente.
Para este cargo, você precisará:
Formação em Engenharia, preferencialmente Elétrica, Eletrônica ou de Automação;
Ter no mínimo 6 anos de experiência comprovada na área de automação industrial, sendo 2 anos na área de óleo e gás (offshore);
Capacidade de interpretar especificações, programas e desenhos técnicos de sistemas de automação;
Conhecimento avançado no pacote MS Office;
Desejável conhecimento do portfólio de produtos da Emerson, tais como: PACSystems RX3i, VersaMax, QuickPanel+, Machine Edition e etc;
Capacidade de especificar, dar suporte e manutenção, e elaborar arquiteturas de redes de automação industrial envolvendo switches, firewalls e rádios industriais;
Disponibilidade para viagens para visitar instalações e escritórios do cliente;
Disponibilidade para trabalho embarcado em plataformas de petróleo, no regime de trabalho 14 x 14;
Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro – RJ;
Idiomas: Português e Inglês avançado.
Nossa cultura e compromisso com você:
Na Emerson, priorizamos um local de trabalho onde todos os colaboradores sejam valorizados, respeitados e capacitados para crescer. Promovemos um ambiente que incentiva a inovação, a colaboração e perspectivas diversas, porque sabemos que grandes ideias vêm de grandes equipes. Nosso compromisso com o desenvolvimento contínuo da carreira e o crescimento de uma cultura inclusiva garantem que você tenha o apoio para prosperar. Seja por meio de orientação, treinamento ou oportunidades de liderança, investimos no seu sucesso para que você possa causar um impacto duradouro. Acreditamos que equipes diversas, trabalhando juntas, são fundamentais para impulsionar o crescimento e entregar resultados de negócios.
Reconhecemos a importância do bem-estar dos colaboradores. Oferecemos convênios médico, odontológico, farmácia e Wellhub (Gympass); seguro de vida; cooperativa de crédito; previdência privada; reconhecimento e muito mais. Nossa cultura de apoio às nossas pessoas oferece grupos de recursos e programa de assistência aos colaboradores, além de licença parental estendida (materna e paterna) por ser Empresa Cidadã.

title: Operations Manager
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide.
Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards.
Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team.
Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):
Operational Leadership
Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics.
Training and Development: Conduct initial and ongoing training for QC Coordinators (QCCs), maintaining minimal errors and supporting development. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators.
IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become "super-users" of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business.
Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives.
Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager.
Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards.
Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum's capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum's strengths in client meetings to support business development.
Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed.
CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager.
Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required.
Team Development
Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start.
Performance and Probation Management: Lead 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews for new hires, ensuring development aligns with company standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations and address skill gaps through targeted training.
Compliance & QHSE
Process Optimisation: Act as a "process expert" within Fulkrum, supporting the Integrated Management System (IMS) and continuous process improvements. Collaborate on IRIS developments and provide training for each improvement.
Focal Point: for QHSE and Compliance during internal/external audits, draft and implement CARs as necessary, support all IMS initiatives for process improvements.
Commercial
Proposal and Contract Support: Support bid preparation, draft project-specific execution plans and procedures, create/approve rate sheets, perform contract renewals, and support all other commercial requirements as needed.
Insurance and Compliance: Coordinate insurance documents, bank letters, and tax documentation, ensuring sufficient coverage for client projects.
Team Culture and Engagement
Team Building: Foster a positive and inclusive office culture, organising team events and maintaining a supportive environment. Promote retention through effective leadership and engagement initiatives.
Engagement: Drive any engagement survey initiatives and follow up on global, regional and local actions to ensure continuous engagement of the team.
Client Account Management
Client Service Reviews: Schedule meetings with key clients to evaluate service quality and implement corrective actions as necessary.
Business Development Support: Assist the Regional Manager and Key Account Managers in bidding, negotiating contracts, presenting to prospective clients, and identifying new business opportunities.
Growth and Forecasting: Monitor project forecasts, ensure proper onboarding of new clients, and communicate budget impacts to the Regional Manager and Finance Department.
Coordination Responsibilities
Client Support: Manage client requests for QA/QC, Engineering, and Project Support, ensuring prompt and accurate fulfilment.
Candidate Management: Source candidates, prepare them for interviews, and coordinate their placement, handling contractual and performance-related concerns throughout their assignments.
Service Level Agreements: Ensure adherence to all client SLAs and Fulkrum KPIs, negotiating inspector rates to support office margins.
Qualifications and Skills
Minimum 10 years of industry experience, with 5 years in a leadership role.
Extensive knowledge of oil and gas projects, both onshore and offshore.
Proficient in MS Office; CRM experience preferred.
Demonstrated client relationship management skills, with the ability to thrive in fast-paced environments.
Personal Attributes
Highly organised, process-oriented, and capable of multitasking.
Strong leadership skills with a proven ability to motivate and guide teams.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Willingness to support personnel and clients outside of standard hours as necessary.
Additional Information:
This is a pivotal role within the organisation, requiring exceptional interpersonal skills, keen attention to detail, and a comprehensive understanding of the oil and gas industry. The ideal candidate will be a strong team leader who consistently delivers the highest standards of service to clients. Candidates with a background in the coordination or management of large projects, a thorough knowledge of Fulkrum's coordination and accounts processes, and a proven ability to build and nurture client relationships will excel in this position. This individual will inspire their team to meet and exceed company goals, driving both performance and growth.
Travel
Travel will frequently be required throughout the Region.
HSE Awareness:
All personnel are informed of Fulkrum's Health and Safety policy and procedures during the onboarding process. Any HSE incidents must be reported and logged with the QHSE Manager, who will oversee and support any subsequent investigations.
Why Join Us?
This is an exciting opportunity for a driven Operations Manager to showcase their expertise in a supportive and collaborative environment. At Fulkrum, you'll make a tangible impact while advancing your career in the thriving global business sector.
We offer a fantastic working environment with a highly engaged team and consistently high eNPS scores. Fulkrum's success in attracting new clients and expanding our global footprint is a testament to our excellence and dedication. We have regular reward and recognition initiatives, a social budget, and a refer-a-friend scheme to ensure our team feels valued and motivated.
Join us to be part of a high-performing team with ample opportunities for skill enhancement and development. Be a part of our success story and contribute to our continued growth and innovation.
Apply now
and become a valued part of our growing team!

title: Product Owner - Consultor(a) Senior
description:
Descrição do perfil
Responsável por liderar a condução de projetos e iniciativas ágeis de ponta a ponta, desde a definição das histórias e priorização do backlog até o acompanhamento da entrega final, assegurando a qualidade e integridade conceitual das entregas. Atua garantindo o alinhamento entre as áreas de negócio e técnica para assegurar que as entregas estejam alinhadas ao escopo definido e aos objetivos da empresa. Além disso, mantém as práticas Scrum, apoia os outros papéis e garante comunicação e colaboração ativa entre squads, atuando como educador para assegurar o respeito aos valores e metodologia ágil.
Principais atividades
Apoiar a gestão de projetos de lançamento de novas ofertas considerando atividades E2E, desde a solicitação do gerente de produto até o delivery técnico;
Definir a visão do produto, seu roadmap e oportunidades de crescimento com os diversos stakeholders;
Construir escopo junto com Líder de Produto, atuando no processo de elaboração de user stories garantindo requisitos necessários e alinhamento de expectativas junto às áreas de negócio;
Liderar grupos multidisciplinares para garantir a correta especificação do produto, ajudando na análise e negociação de impactos diretamente com as áreas de negócio;
Desafiar as áreas de negócio acerca de features de produtos, processos ou regras;
Traduzir a estratégia de negócios para o time técnico, garantindo o entendimento dos requisitos;
Negociar escopos prioritários com foco na estratégia de negócios, discutindo trade-offs estratégicos;
Validar refinamentos técnicos garantindo aderência ao escopo solicitado;
Conduzir cerimônias ágeis de alta transversalidade (diversas esteiras/sprints de desenvolvimento), centralizando decisões estratégicas;
Elaborar critérios de aceite para garantir alinhamento com demais times envolvidos, assegurando visão única de projeto/produto;
Realizar a validação e aprovação dos testes garantindo a qualidade da entrega e coordenar aprovação dos demais times envolvidos;
Acompanhar entrega e performance dos testes pós-produção para garantir funcionamento e velocidade na correção;
Apontar issues para serem endereçados pelo time técnico identificado;
Controlar cronograma e budget dos projetos garantindo aderência à estratégia;
Manter um olhar atento, crítico e propositivo durante todas as etapas do projeto, utilizando dados, aprendizados e feedbacks para monitorar a aderência ao processo e propor melhorias contínuas de forma assertiva;
Garantir a manutenção das práticas Scrum, apoiar os papéis envolvidos e manter a comunicação e colaboração ativa entre squads;
Atuar como educador para assegurar que todos os participantes conheçam e respeitem os princípios e valores do Scrum.
Conhecimento, Experiência e Formação

  • Experiência como Product Owner, Project Manager ou Scrum Master com atuação prática em projetos ágeis;
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) e práticas de gestão de backlog, elaboração de histórias e releases;
  • Capacidade de atuar com diferentes stakeholders e áreas técnicas, negociando escopos e prazos;
  • Habilidade para escrever e organizar user stories, critérios de aceite e planos de entrega;
  • Conhecimento em rituais ágeis e na condução de cerimônias com múltiplas esteiras ou times;
  • Perfil analítico, estruturado e com forte senso de responsabilidade pela entrega de valor;
  • Ferramentas de gestão de projetos (Azure, Jira, Monday;
  • Boa capacidade de articulação, visão crítica e habilidade de propor melhorias processuais com base em experiência prática;
  • Inglês avançado é obrigatório;
  • Graduação Completa em Administração/Marketing/Tecnologia/Engenharia.

title: Operations Manager
description:
Fulkrum is a global leader in inspection, expediting, auditing, and technical staffing services, delivering exceptional solutions to the energy, engineering, and construction industries for over 14 years. Headquartered in the UK, we have established a strong presence across six continents, serving more than 300 clients worldwide.

Our commitment to excellence has been recognised with prestigious awards, including the King's Award for Enterprise in International Trade (2023), the People and Competency Award at the EIC Awards (2023), and the Scale-Up Award at the WESCA North America Awards (2024). Most recently, Fulkrum was named the 2025 winner in the People, Culture & Optimisation category at the EIC North & Central America Regional Awards.

Our Brazil Office is currently seeking a highly motivated and experienced Operations Manager to join our dynamic team.


Main Responsibilities (include but are not limited to):

Operational Leadership

  • Efficiency and Compliance: Guide the team in operational excellence through regular training and adherence to work instructions, ensuring timely responses, accurate reporting, and proper use of the IRIS system, Integrated Management System, and all company policies, processes, and procedures. Overall responsibility for leadership and support, which enables the team and Region to meet and surpass KPIs and Quality Metrics.
  • Training and Development: Conduct initial and ongoing training for QC Coordinators (QCCs), maintaining minimal errors and supporting development. Ensure the gap analysis assessment is completed for all new starters and, as needed, for experienced coordinators.
  • IRIS Compliance: Oversee IRIS accuracy and compliance for the Region, ensuring client and inspector profiles, rates, assignments, and reports are up-to-date and meet Fulkrum standards. Operations Managers should become “super-users” of IRIS, driving continuous improvements throughout the team and the business.
  • Financial Oversight: Improve cash flow and reduce the Cash Conversion Cycle (CCC) by supporting Accounts and managing invoicing challenges between departments, reducing errors and minimising un-invoiced visits, ensuring POs and approvals are received on time, supporting credit control escalations, and reporting issues promptly and consistently to Senior Management. Identify areas for improvement between coordination and accounts, suggest process improvements, draft Corrective Action Reports (CARs), and support cash flow and credit control objectives.
  • Budget Management: Support the Regional Manager in budget maintenance, report on client activity levels, and drive financial efficiencies. Monitor and manage office expenses and personnel utilisation. Recommend improvements to the Regional Manager.
  • Gross Profit Targets: Ensure gross profit objectives by overseeing client and inspector negotiations, minimising reliance on agencies, and upholding service standards.
  • Growth and Client Engagement: Collaborate with Sales to highlight Fulkrum’s capabilities and successes, recommend growth opportunities, and support the acquisition of new clients and service lines. Present IRIS and Fulkrum’s strengths in client meetings to support business development.
  • Client Retention: Schedule reviews with key clients, addressing service quality and identifying any gaps for improvement. Maintain client relationships through regular communication and promptly address any issues to ensure satisfaction. Report concerns to the Regional Manager as needed.
  • CRM and Reporting: Document client interactions in Salesforce, compile monthly reports, and highlight successes, challenges, and key client insights for the Regional Manager.
  • Overhead Management: Regularly assess team workloads to maintain operational efficiencies, minimise redundancies, and support overhead budget goals. Propose staffing adjustments to the Regional Manager as required.


Team Development

  • Recruitment and Onboarding: Collaborate with HR to recruit and onboard new team members, ensuring resources and support are ready for a smooth start.
  • Performance and Probation Management: Lead 30-, 60-, and 90-day reviews for new hires, ensuring development aligns with company standards. Conduct regular performance evaluations and address skill gaps through targeted training.


Compliance & QHSE

  • Process Optimisation: Act as a “process expert” within Fulkrum, supporting the Integrated Management System (IMS) and continuous process improvements. Collaborate on IRIS developments and provide training for each improvement.
  • Focal Point: for QHSE and Compliance during internal/external audits, draft and implement CARs as necessary, support all IMS initiatives for process improvements.


Commercial

  • Proposal and Contract Support: Support bid preparation, draft project-specific execution plans and procedures, create/approve rate sheets, perform contract renewals, and support all other commercial requirements as needed.
  • Insurance and Compliance: Coordinate insurance documents, bank letters, and tax documentation, ensuring sufficient coverage for client projects.


Team Culture and Engagement

  • Team Building: Foster a positive and inclusive office culture, organising team events and maintaining a supportive environment. Promote retention through effective leadership and engagement initiatives.
  • Engagement: Drive any engagement survey initiatives and follow up on global, regional and local actions to ensure continuous engagement of the team.


Client Account Management

  • Client Service Reviews: Schedule meetings with key clients to evaluate service quality and implement corrective actions as necessary.
  • Business Development Support: Assist the Regional Manager and Key Account Managers in bidding, negotiating contracts, presenting to prospective clients, and identifying new business opportunities.
  • Growth and Forecasting: Monitor project forecasts, ensure proper onboarding of new clients, and communicate budget impacts to the Regional Manager and Finance Department.


Coordination Responsibilities

  • Client Support: Manage client requests for QA/QC, Engineering, and Project Support, ensuring prompt and accurate fulfilment.
  • Candidate Management: Source candidates, prepare them for interviews, and coordinate their placement, handling contractual and performance-related concerns throughout their assignments.
  • Service Level Agreements: Ensure adherence to all client SLAs and Fulkrum KPIs, negotiating inspector rates to support office margins.


Qualifications and Skills

  • Minimum 10 years of industry experience, with 5 years in a leadership role.
  • Extensive knowledge of oil and gas projects, both onshore and offshore.
  • Proficient in MS Office;
    CRM experience preferred.
  • Demonstrated client relationship management skills, with the ability to thrive in fast-paced environments.


Personal Attributes

  • Highly organised, process-oriented, and capable of multitasking.
  • Strong leadership skills with a proven ability to motivate and guide teams.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Willingness to support personnel and clients outside of standard hours as necessary.


Additional Information:

This is a pivotal role within the organisation, requiring exceptional interpersonal skills, keen attention to detail, and a comprehensive understanding of the oil and gas industry. The ideal candidate will be a strong team leader who consistently delivers the highest standards of service to clients. Candidates with a background in the coordination or management of large projects, a thorough knowledge of Fulkrum’s coordination and accounts processes, and a proven ability to build and nurture client relationships will excel in this position. This individual will inspire their team to meet and exceed company goals, driving both performance and growth.


Travel

Travel will frequently be required throughout the Region.


HSE Awareness:

All personnel are informed of Fulkrum’s Health and Safety policy and procedures during the onboarding process. Any HSE incidents must be reported and logged with the QHSE Manager, who will oversee and support any subsequent investigations.

Why Join Us?

This is an exciting opportunity for a driven Operations Manager to showcase their expertise in a supportive and collaborative environment. At Fulkrum, you’ll make a tangible impact while advancing your career in the thriving global business sector.


We offer a fantastic working environment with a highly engaged team and consistently high eNPS scores. Fulkrum's success in attracting new clients and expanding our global footprint is a testament to our excellence and dedication. We have regular reward and recognition initiatives, a social budget, and a refer-a-friend scheme to ensure our team feels valued and motivated.


Join us to be part of a high-performing team with ample opportunities for skill enhancement and development. Be a part of our success story and contribute to our continued growth and innovation.


Apply now and become a valued part of our growing team!

Fulkrum
